title: Integration test: import 10k-article mbox, verify full CID index
description:
Generate or obtain a 10,000-article mbox corpus (synthetic data acceptable). Run the mbox importer, then run the reindex tool, and verify that all 10,000 Message-IDs are present in the index with valid CIDs. Assert that retrieving each CID from IPFS returns the original article bytes. Artifact: tests/import_10k.rs or tests/import_10k.sh.

Acceptance:
- All 10,000 articles indexed after mbox import
- All 10,000 CIDs retrievable from IPFS
- Reindex tool produces identical index to the original import
- Test completes in under 5 minutes on a laptop
- Test is headless and deterministic (synthetic corpus)
